text: Return only the raw HCDR sequences for an antibody with function: A human Fab (IGHV3/IGKV1-Kappa), targeting the receptor binding domain of the SARS-CoV-2 spike glycoprotein. The receptor binding domain engages human ACE2 on the host cell surface and is the principal target of neutralizing humoral responses. The antibody is designed as a neutralizing antibody that blocks the receptor binding interface, capable of retaining activity against circulating variants.

Return only the raw HCDR sequences for an antibody with function: A cynomolgus macaque Fab (IGHV5/IGKV2-Kappa), targeting the Envelope glycoprotein E2 of Eastern equine encephalitis virus. The Envelope glycoprotein E2 forms 80 spikes composed of trimers of E1-E2 heterodimers that mediate viral attachment and membrane fusion during infection. The antibody is designed as a neutralizing antibody elicited by immunization with alphavirus-like particles, capable of protecting against multiple alphavirus species.
